plugins.name: Fleet ACP

description.en: Delegate a task to any Agent Client Protocol v1 coding agent installed on the remote machine.
description.zh: 把任务交给远端机器上已经安装的任意 Agent Client Protocol v1 编码 Agent。

plugins.body:
# Fleet ACP

Fleet ACP is an MIT-licensed bridge between Fleet and Agent Client Protocol v1.
The remote machine owns its ACP-compatible agent, account, model, and API keys.
The plugin only initializes that local process, creates a session, delegates a
prompt, and returns streamed output through the existing Fleet task ticket.

Install it by asking an AI connected to Fleet Tool to call `install_plugin` with
`plugin_id` set to `fleet.acp`. Software changes always require confirmation on
the target device.

plugins.name: Fleet Transfer

description.en: Send one file directly between two approved Fleet endpoints without relaying file bytes through the Hub.
description.zh: 在两个已确认的 Fleet 端点之间直接传输单个文件，文件字节不经过 Hub 中转。

plugins.body:
# Fleet Transfer

`fleet.transfer` is the official file-system adapter for Fleet's direct-only
file transfer path. Fleet core authenticates the account and endpoints, signs a
short-lived WebRTC ticket, and requires explicit approval on both devices. The
plugin then reads or writes one regular file through a bounded streaming ABI.

File bytes use a dedicated reliable WebRTC DataChannel. The Worker and Durable
Object carry only authentication, signaling, status, and short-lived tickets.
If a direct connection cannot be established, the transfer fails instead of
falling back to WebSocket, Worker, R2, TURN, or another relay.

Version 0.1.0 supports one file, SHA-256 integrity, verified resume checkpoints,
safe cancellation, and no-clobber publication. Directories, symbolic links,
special files, overwrite, and cross-account transfer are deliberately excluded.
